entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, you just got sprung yesterday![n]You're already back at school? What[n]a model student!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Orrrrr, could it be because today's[n]Valentine's Day?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Every single guy obsessing over this shit[n]today tries that line at least once, y'know.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: At this point, I'd accept even some[n]pity present.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, take your seat already! I'd like to[n]get out of this bag before I lose all the[n]feeling in my paws, thank you very much.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, uhhh... I know this is super late, but...[n]thanks, dude.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Like, it's all on you that we're even[n]still here, yeah?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The rest of us were all in the chopper,[n]and the next thing we knew, we were[n]all in Odaiba...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That reminds me—I wonder how[n]Doc's doin'...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah, but first: Sumire told me[n]to tell you thanks, too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She said somethin' about havin' a big[n]meet next month, so she's gonna focus[n]on practice for now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, Sumire's really goin' for it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ah, it can wait for next month—once[n]Makoto and Haru finish up their[n]entrance exams.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh! No wonder it's so cramped in here[n]today...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's chocolate inside. Trust me,[n]my nose knows.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But the question is: who left it here?
